trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer transaction mode for dashboard latency
trello.desc: Investigate dashboard slowness for accounts with many projects caused by database connection contention, not query cost. Assigned to Raj. Steps: 1) Set up a load test that mirrors the dashboard's query pattern and connection usage. 2) Run baseline measurement of p95 latency with current connection setup. 3) Deploy/configure PgBouncer in transaction mode and run the same load test. 4) Compare p95 latency with and without PgBouncer. Acceptance criteria: Load test setup and query pattern documented, p95 latency numbers for both configurations captured, summary results prepared to present at next product sync.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc: Marketing identified typo 'recieve' in onboarding email subject line. Assigned to Tom. Steps: 1) Locate the onboarding email template in the email template repo. 2) Correct subject line spelling to 'receive'. 3) Push fix to repo today. 4) Submit for re-approval per email change process. Acceptance criteria: Subject line spelling corrected in repo, change merged, re-approval recorded, and no remaining instances of 'recieve' in the onboarding email.

trello.name: Update roadmap doc for dark mode placement
trello.desc: Roadmap currently shows dark mode under 'Q3 committed' which is inaccurate after decision to defer. Assigned to Tom. Steps: 1) Open the current roadmap document. 2) Remove dark mode from Q3 committed standalone item. 3) Move dark mode reference under the September design-system upgrade line, noting theming is included with that upgrade. 4) Save and publish updated roadmap. Acceptance criteria: Dark mode is no longer listed as a standalone Q3 commitment, it is clearly shown as included with September design-system upgrade, preventing sales from promising it as standalone.
